он.declInfo: The forms with н- are used if after a preposition. Ex: пода́рок для него́

она.declInfo:
The forms with н- are used after prepositions, for example: Без неё нельзя. - It’s impossible without her.

е́ю is the older, historical instrumental form. In Old Russian and Church Slavonic, the instrumental singular feminine ending was -ею. Modern Russian retained ей as the standard, but е́ю survived in:
Poetry — for meter and rhyme
High literary prose — for stylistic effect
Set phrases and fixed expressions
Official/legal documents (occasionally)

они.declInfo: The forms with н- are used after prepositions, for example: она́ ме́жду ни́ми - she is between them.
